mapper.select: SELECT * from ( SELECT id as id ,sender_id as senderId, receiver_id as receiverId ,content as content ,fileId as fileId ,msg_type as msgType, createTime as createTime FROM im_chat_message WHERE (sender_id = #{senderId} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId}) OR (sender_id = #{receiverId} AND receiver_id = #{senderId}) ORDER BY msg_time desc LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit} ) t ORDER BY createTime asc

SELECT t1.user_id as id,t1.avatar as avatar,t1.im_online_status as online, (SELECT MAX(msg_time) FROM im_chat_message WHERE (sender_id =#{userId} AND receiver_id = t1.user_id) OR (sender_id = t1.user_id AND receiver_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY msg_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) as lastMsgTime, (SELECT content FROM im_chat_message WHERE (sender_id = #{userId} AND receiver_id = t1.user_id) OR (sender_id = t1.user_id AND receiver_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY msg_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMsgContent, (SELECT msg_type FROM im_chat_message WHERE (sender_id = #{userId} AND receiver_id = t1.user_id) OR (sender_id = t1.user_id AND receiver_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY msg_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMsgType
from sys_user t1 where t1.user_id !=#{userId} and t1.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY lastMsgContent desc
mapper.insert: insert into im_chat_message( id, sender_id, receiver_id, content, msg_type, status, msg_time, fileId, createTime )values( #{id}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, #{msgType}, #{status}, #{msgTime}, #{fileId}, sysdate() )
